name: Battle of Alarcos
note: The accounts do not give the compass directions, so the Castilians are placed at the top and the Almohads at the bottom. The accounts say the Almohads formed around La Cabeza and that the Castilians came down from a high position, but not where either lay, so the hill is placed inside the Almohad formation and the fortress by judgement. The Arab left is placed on the left of the Almohad line as the accounts give it.

terrain.name: La Cabeza
terrain.quote: a small hill called La Cabeza

terrain.name: Alarcos
terrain.quote: where a fortress was under construction

units.name: Castilian heavy cavalry
units.quote: put most of his heavy cavalry in a compact group, about 8,000 strong

units.name: Castilian infantry and Orders
units.quote: The king himself would follow with the infantry and the Military Orders.

units.name: Knights who reached Alarcos
units.quote: had to seek refuge in the unfinished fortress of Alarcos with just a fraction of his knights

units.name: Bani Marin and Zenata
units.leader: Abu Jalil Mahyu ibn Abi Bakr
units.quote: On the first line were the Bani Marin volunteers under Abu Jalil Mahyu ibn Abi Bakr complete with a large number of archers and the Zenata tribe

units.name: Vizier's Hintata guard
units.quote: behind them was the vizier with the Amir's banner and his personal guard, from the Hintata tribe

units.name: Arab hosts of the left
units.quote: to the left were the Arab hosts under Yarmun ibn Riyah

units.name: Andalusi forces of the right
units.quote: to the right were the al-Andalus forces under the popular Caid Ibn Sanadid

units.name: Almohad rearguard
units.quote: Al-Mansur himself held command of the rearguard, which consisted of the best Almohad forces

phases.title: The two armies form up
phases.text: The Almohads formed around the hill of La Cabeza in a vanguard and a rearguard. The Castilian king placed his heavy cavalry in one compact group and kept the infantry and Military Orders to follow.
phases.quote: the Almohad army formed for battle around a small hill called La Cabeza, two bow-shots from Alarcos

phases.title: The Castilian cavalry charges down
phases.text: Alfonso chose to move first. His forces came down from their high position and the heavy cavalry charged across the lower plain into the front lines of the Muslims.
phases.quote: ordered his forces to descend from their high position with the heavy cavalry charging across the lower plain

phases.title: The front line is scattered and the vizier killed
phases.text: In a three hour engagement the knights first dispersed the Bani Marin and the Zenatas, then attacked the Hintata and killed the vizier Abu Yahya.
phases.quote: they first dispersed the Bani Marin and the Zenatas, then attacked the Hintata killing the vizier Abu Yahya

phases.title: The Andalusi forces are routed
phases.text: The knights then struggled against the al-Andalus forces of Ibn Sanadid and routed them, but they were fatigued and men were falling.
phases.quote: finally struggled against and routed the al-Andalus forces of Ibn Sanadid

phases.title: The Almohad flank and rearguard surround the knights
phases.text: As the Christians tired and fell, the Arab left under Yarmun enveloped their flank and rear. The Almohad rearguard under al-Mansur then attacked and surrounded the knights.
phases.quote: the Arab left led by Yarmun enveloped their flank and rear. At this point, the Almohad rearguard led by al-Mansur attacked, surrounding the Christian knights

phases.title: Alfonso commits the remaining forces
phases.text: Alfonso advanced with all his remaining forces into the melee and was assaulted from all sides under a rain of arrows. His bodyguard removed him from the action and they fled to Toledo.
phases.quote: Alfonso advanced with all his remaining forces into the melee, only to find himself assaulted from all sides under a rain of arrows

phases.title: The infantry is destroyed and the knights reach Alarcos
phases.text: The Castilian infantry was destroyed together with most of the Orders. López de Haro tried to break through the ring and took refuge in the unfinished fortress of Alarcos with a fraction of his knights.
phases.quote: The Castilian infantry was destroyed, together with most of the Orders which had supported them
